messages:
alex: Heads-up — RC branch freeze in 2h (18:00 PT). If you need a version bump or changelog line, push PRs now and tag @release-captain. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
marie: pushing a 0.14.2 bump for the kv-cache fix, PR #4832 incoming.
marie: small changelog entry: 
```
- fix(kv-cache): avoid leak when sequence length < 128 (marie)
```
alex: thx. keep it single-line in changelog.md please so the auto-parser picks it up.
darren: heads up, the migration in #4829 still has one failing test on CI — will try to land a patch in the next 30m. If it stays flaky we should consider skipping for this RC.
tara: injecting a potential slip — regression on long prompts during load testing. failing reliably in canary env. cc @srebot
srebot: canary health check failed at 2026-03-17T15:40:22Z — CPU spike on node gpu-12, auto-restart triggered. See /infra/canaries/1772102468
release-captain: ok team — two options: 1) hold cutoff until 19:00 PT to let darren + tara fix, or 2) cut RC and hotfix tomorrow. We need a decision by 17:45 PT. Please react with :thumbsup: to hold, :eyes: to cut now and hotfix.
ryan: drafting the public status message for #announcements. Current ETA in draft: "RC rollout at 18:00 PT — monitoring, expect 30m canary." If we hold I'll change ETA to 19:30 PT and add a short note about a potential hotfix.
marie: if we hold, I can get the changelog/publish ready and run the final QA pass.
darren: requesting the hold — I'll prioritize the migration fix. :+1:
alex: agreed — holding sounds safer. I'll update the release checklist and set cutoff to 19:00 PT.
ryan: updated announcement draft: 
"We are pausing the RC cut for up to 1.5 hours due to a canary regression. New tentative cut: 19:00 PT. We will post a follow-up when canary is green or if we opt to cut and ship a hotfix."
release-captain: perfect. I'll notify legal/comms if we end up slipping the public window.
deploy-bot: Canary window extended by 45m for this RC per request of @release-captain.
ryan: once canary is green I'll post the final timestamp in #announcements and tag @customers. if we end up cutting now and hotfixing, please flag required rollback docs in the PR description.
tara: running additional load tests now, will post logs in thread in 10m.
alex: thanks everyone. quick checklist: bump PRs merged, changelog entries formatted, release notes draft in /docs/releases/0.14.2.md, update @release-captain when ready.
